sheet: GDRFA - Email & Notification Translation Sheet (English to Arabic)

for_client: Fill the 'ar' field for every entry.
Do NOT translate placeholder tokens inside {curly braces} — they are replaced at runtime with real data.
Return the completed file; the developer will integrate the Arabic into the system.

items.en: GDRFA - Your Facility Request Status Changed
You're Invited to a Sports Activity!

subsections.name: Registration status email (cancelled / approved / advanced / rejected)

items.en: Your request to participate in the following event has been {Status}.
Your registration has been cancelled by the event administrator.
Your registration has been re-approved by the event administrator.
Your request has been forwarded to the next approver.
✅ We look forward to your participation in the event.
❌ Your registration has been cancelled by the administrator.
If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the event administrator.
❌ Unfortunately, your request could not be approved at this time.

subsections.name: Common table labels (registration status / admin notification emails)

items.en: General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs
Sports & Recreation Department - Event Management System
We would like to inform you that your team member {Member} has successfully registered for an event. Please find the complete details below:
This is an automated notification to keep you informed about your team member's event participation. Please review the details and contact us if you require any additional information.
Your facility request status has been updated. Here are the details:
If you have any questions regarding this request, please contact our support team.
You recently requested to reset your password. Click the button below to reset it.
If you did not request a password reset, you can ignore this email.
A new participant has registered for your event {Event}. Please review the details below and take appropriate action if needed.
Contact participant if additional information is needed
Update event participant list and manage capacity
Take action on pending approvals if required
This is an automated notification from the GDRFA Sports Management System.
You are receiving this email because you are listed as an administrator for this event.

subsections.name: Activity invitation email (employee invited to sports activity)

items.en: We are excited to inform you that you have been invited to participate in a new activity. This is a great opportunity to engage in sports and recreational activities.
Please log in to the GDRFA Sports Portal to view the full event details, check the schedule, and confirm your participation.
If you have any questions, please contact your event coordinator.
For any questions or concerns, please contact your event coordinator or system administrator.

notes_for_developer: Source files examined: Node/controllers/commonController.js, Node/controllers/api/authController.js, Node/controllers/adminApi/adminAuthController.js, Node/controllers/api/pageController.js, Node/controllers/adminApi/participantController.js, Node/controllers/adminApi/eventAdminController.js, Node/controllers/api/facilitiesController.js, Node/controllers/api/contactUsController.js, Node/cron/autoEscalation.js, Node/utils/PushNotificationUtil.js, Node/utils/emailService.js, Node/controllers/api/notificationController.js, Node/controllers/api/testNotificationController.js.

Orphan email templates exist in Node/views/emails/ but are NOT wired to any sendEmail call (dead/legacy): team-player-assignment.ejs, regular-event-assignment.ejs, employee-add-to-manager.ejs, email-set-password-template.ejs, coordinator-template.ejs, admin-facility-request-notification.ejs. If translated, they would need wiring; consider removing or wiring separately.
Dead code: Node/legacy emailTemplates/resetPasswordTemplate.js references a non-existent reset-password.html.
Dead notification: commonController.js:888-898 has a commented-out 'Facility Request Status Changed' in-app notification.

Existing Arabic: some in-app notifications already store both title_ar/message_ar (D-table entries). The Arabic fields above should be filled with the client's Arabic to replace/verify the hardcoded Arabic already present.
